A SURVIVOR’S FIELD GUIDE

Make a little
light in the dark.

Choose a location on the map, then choose a task. Work takes time. When 160 hours have passed, the wave arrives.

  1. Find your footing. Salvage the scrap yard and restore your outpost.
  2. Look beyond the trees. Survey the ridge to reveal the abandoned fields, depot, and river crossing. Explore the fields to discover Briar farm.
  3. You’re not alone. Repair the bridge. Bring food to the survivors on the far bank.
  4. Hold the line. Reach 12 defense and 3 survivors before the wave. Barricades can be built more than once.

You can pause an active task. Time stands still between tasks. Each new run earns knowledge, making work faster and preserving the silhouettes of places you found.
